faqHeading: Last Minute Movers FAQ for Boston Customers

faq.q: Can last minute movers in Boston move me today?
faq.a: Sometimes. We take urgent moves whenever a crew is available, so call (617) 668-1807 and we'll tell you whether we can do it.

faq.q: How is a last minute move billed?
faq.a: Like any local move: hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.

faq.q: What's the fastest way to book an urgent move?
faq.a: Call us. The quote form works too, but a phone call gets you an answer on crew availability sooner.

faq.q: Can you pack for me if I haven't started?
faq.a: Yes. Add packing to the move and the crew packs as part of the job. Expect it to add time to the hourly total.

faq.q: Is September 1 a bad day for a last minute move in Boston?
faq.a: It's the hardest day. So many Boston leases turn over on September 1 that crews are booked well ahead, so urgent moves near that date are less likely to fit.

faq.q: What should I have ready when I call?
faq.a: Your move date, the size of your home, both addresses and anything that slows a move down, like stairs or a missing elevator booking. With that, we can check crew availability and explain the price on the same call.

faqClosing: Still have a question about an urgent move? Our FAQ page covers billing, booking and moving day.
